caption: The drawing features a square textile pattern centered on a beige or off-white background. The pattern is composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines forming a grid, with the lines predominantly in shades of blue. Within the grid, some areas are filled with tighter cross-hatching, creating a denser and darker blue appearance, while other sections remain lighter with fewer lines, allowing more of the beige background to show through. The lines vary in thickness and intensity, giving the design a checked or plaid effect. Surrounding the textile pattern, the background is plain and contains scattered small brownish spots or marks. At the bottom, there are handwritten inscriptions: on the left, "Westchester County," and on the right, "Dan. Fletcher."
title: Piece of Handwoven Linen
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
